nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Green marketing strategies_qna_000
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How can marketing strategies for dairy alternatives be more effective?
nodes.answer: Marketing strategies should focus on highlighting the sensory and functional benefits of dairy alternatives, in addition to emphasizing the positive environmental, ethical, and welfare factors associated with these products.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Green marketing strategies_qna_001
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: How do message framings and green practices impact customers' attitudes and behaviour intentions towards green restaurants according to Xu and Jeong (2019)?
nodes.answer: Message framings and green practices influence customers' attitudes and behaviour intentions towards green restaurants.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Green marketing strategies_qna_002
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What strategies can be utilized to target healthy and sustainability-involved consumers effectively?
nodes.answer: Policy and marketing strategies targeting healthy and sustainability-involved consumers can address a similar individual profile. Communication-based tools like information and education campaigns can be combined to enhance effectiveness, leveraging consumer self-identities for better results.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Green marketing strategies_qna_003
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: How can businesses use green advertising to influence collectivist consumer behaviour?
nodes.answer: Green advertising can influence collectivist consumer behaviour by appealing to their values and beliefs in sustainability and community well-being.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Green marketing strategies_qna_004
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What are the effects of functional green advertising on individuals and their perceptions of others?
nodes.answer: Functional green advertising has been found to positively impact individuals by promoting sustainable behaviour, as well as shaping their perceptions of others who engage in eco-friendly practices.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Green marketing strategies_qna_005
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What was the focus of the bibliometric analysis conducted by Wang et al. (2023) in the field of green marketing?
nodes.answer: Wang et al. (2023) conducted a bibliometric analysis focusing on green marketing in marketing and related fields, covering the period from 1991 to 2021.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Green marketing strategies_qna_006
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the green premium, and how does it relate to consumer attitudes towards bio-based products?
nodes.answer: The green premium refers to the higher price that consumers are willing to pay for bio-based or "green" products, serving as a proxy for their environmental concern.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Green marketing strategies_qna_007
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What factors have been extensively studied in relation to green consumption, according to various scholars?
nodes.answer: Scholars have extensively focused on factors such as green awareness, perceived knowledge, eco-concern, green label, perceived trust, green values, gender, religiosity, spirituality, and attitude.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Product life-cycle analysis|Green marketing strategies_qna_008
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What are some factors that influence green purchase behaviour according to Joshi and Rahman (2015)?
nodes.answer: Factors such as environmental concern, awareness, and perceived consumer effectiveness were found to influence green purchase behaviour.
